conference: SALGBA Annual (State and Local Government Benefits Association) 2026 National Conference
source_note: The official SALGBA 2026 onsite program (PDF), published by the association itself in the S3 bucket that serves salgba.org's file library (bucket amo_hub_content, prefix Association119/files/, the store behind the site's wp-amo plugin). This is the final program revision, 'SALGBA2026 Program-9(Red2).pdf', last modified 2026-05-04 - the conference's own opening day. TWO SECTIONS OF IT ARE USED. (1) Page 57, 'Exhibit Hall List - Alphabetical', is the exhibitor list proper: 88 companies, each with a booth number, and it is the source of every name and booth recorded here. (2) Pages 58-66 are the sponsor pages - Premier (58-61), Diamond (62), Platinum (63-65), Silver and Bronze (66) - and are the only source of the 'tier' levels and of every 'sells' line. The exhibit hall list itself says nothing about what anyone sells and prints no websites, so a company that took a booth but bought no sponsorship has sells null; that is most of the list. PAIRING NAMES TO BOOTHS: page 57 is laid out as two column-pairs and the program is a Canva export whose right-hand column of names sits in a nested form XObject, so a naive text extraction returns all 88 names and then all 88 booth numbers as two separate runs. The left column (44 names, 9amHealth through Linea Solutions) was read row by row with pdfminer, which resolves it directly and unambiguously. The right column (44 names, Lucid Diagnostics through WEX) was paired by order, both runs being alphabetical, and then checked against two outside sources that state their own booth independently: navigatewell.com gives Navigate booth 406 and laborfirst.com/retireefirst gives booth 218, and the order-pairing puts Navigate Wellbeing Solutions at 406 and Retiree First at 218. TWO ANOMALIES IN THE SOURCE, both left as printed: booth 430 is printed twice, against Included Health and against Partnership Health Centers; and Wellworks For You has 'Screen' where a booth number belongs, apparently a floor-plan position rather than a numbered booth. THREE MISSPELLINGS in the exhibit hall list, recorded as the list prints them and flagged for correction on intake - 'Evernoth Health Services' (the program's own sponsor page spells it Evernorth Health Services), 'WebMD Health Servies' (sponsor page: WebMD Health Services), and the Bronze sponsor 'Solrera Health' (almost certainly Solera Health, whose own site carries a SALGBA 2026 page). Where the sponsor pages spell a company differently from the exhibit hall list, an 'also_printed_as' field carries the sponsor-page spelling. FIVE COMPANIES ARE SPONSORS WITH NO BOOTH on the exhibit hall list - CVS Caremark, Aon, Solrera Health, Wondr Health and Candesa Pharmacy Solution - and are recorded with their tier and booth noted as absent. CVS is the one judgement call: the exhibit hall list carries 'CVS Health' (booth 100) and 'CVS Healthspire' (booth 104), and the program separately names 'CVS Caremark' as a Premier sponsor, so CVS Caremark is kept as its own printed name rather than merged. Websites are null except for the four companies whose own blurb prints a URL. The 'tier' field carries the sponsor level and the booth number together because the output schema has one field for both. CROSS-CHECKS AND DEAD ENDS: the conference's Cvent registration site (web.cvent.com/event/af1ad26a-1971-4c80-8db6-67e29beaf7cf) has been taken down and its archived captures render nothing, salgba.org/events has already rolled over to the 2027 Madison meeting, and the members.salgba.org portal is behind a login; the logo carousel on salgba.org is the association's year-round corporate sponsor roster, NOT this conference's exhibitor list, and was deliberately not used. 'SALGBA2026 Final Floor Plan.pdf' in the same bucket is vector art with no extractable text and page 56 of the program, the Exhibit Hall Map, is a flat image, so neither could confirm the booth pairing; the outside booth citations above stand in for them. The 'SALGBA 2026 Exhibitor Service Manual.pdf' is Capital Convention Contractors logistics and names no exhibitors. Event is PAST: it ran May 4-7, 2026 at the Rhode Island Convention Center in Providence, RI (the exhibit hall ran May 4-6). Fetched 2026-08-25 from the live S3 bucket; no archive needed.
